items.label: SICC annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-28-2026)
items.signal_prefix: New applications (annual report): the company said semi-insulating SiC substrates

set.signal: New applications (annual report): the company said semi-insulating SiC substrates are now used as the heat-dissipation layer of high-power laser chips, in batch shipments; for AI data-center power it is working closely with leading global power-device makers on next-generation power-management chips; in advanced packaging it is working with leading global customers on SiC application breakthroughs, and it reports key technical breakthroughs in products including advanced-packaging heat-dissipation interposers. It says its substrates serve AI data-center high-efficiency power supplies, PSU, HVDC and SST, and that it has business relationships with more than half of the world's top ten power-semiconductor device makers.

items.reason: The report does not link the advanced-packaging customer work to interposers: the customer sentence (p20) names no product; the interposer appears separately as a product line with key technical breakthroughs (p14). Reworded so the two statements are not merged.
items.evidence: 在先进封装领域，公司配合全球头部客户推进 SiC 的应用突破 (p20); 公司也在半绝缘衬底、导电型衬底、P 型衬底、光学衬底、先进封装散热中介层等多元化产品上取得关键技术突破 (p14)
